notes: Void maturity activation is monotone and saturating but its scale must be frozen from void data only.
Web activation may be signed or anisotropic and must be frozen from environment labels before growth or lensing scoring.
Path activation is observer/path dependent and must be selected from source-side lensing or mask data rather than residual improvements.
Time readout activation is a consistency shell for observed a(t) and H(t) reconstructions and is not a clock anomaly claim.
